name: Tun Razak Exchange (TRX)
status_detail: Partially operational · financial district; later towers in progress
summary: Malaysia's international financial district on a 70-acre site off Jalan Tun Razak, anchored by the Exchange 106 tower and TRX towers, with its own MRT interchange.
why_it_matters: KL's flagship financial district, built around a rail interchange. Its fill-up rate signals whether Kuala Lumpur can anchor a regional financial centre.
questions_to_follow: Which remaining plots break ground next?
Does the retail and park layer (TRX City Park) drive sustained footfall?
location_precision: Area-level marker at the district centre.

history.event: TRX MRT interchange station opens ahead of the district.
